name: TechBucket
tagline: A Nepal-based full-stack IT company delivering software, cybersecurity, networking, cloud, data and managed services — with healthcare as our flagship vertical — since 2019.

hero.title: Technology That Moves Your Business Forward
hero.subtitle: We are a full-stack IT company: custom software, cybersecurity, networking, cloud and data, consulting, managed IT and genuine infrastructure products — delivered end-to-end for every industry across Nepal. Healthcare is our flagship vertical, where we build purpose-built hospital software and clinical solutions trusted by providers across the Kathmandu Valley and beyond.

about.title: Full-Stack IT Services, Healthcare at the Core
paragraphs: TechBucket Pvt. Ltd. is a Nepal-based full-stack IT company. We design, build, and maintain software, secure networks, cloud and data platforms, and managed services that move organisations forward — with healthcare at the heart of what we do, from hospital management software that improves patient outcomes to clinical workflows that keep providers focused on care.

Founded in 2019, we started in healthcare IT and grew into a complete technology partner — delivering purpose-built software for hospitals while supplying servers, networking, storage and power protection, and serving education, finance, hospitality, manufacturing and retail across Nepal.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To democratise technology for every organisation in Nepal — starting with healthcare — by delivering affordable, scalable and reliable digital solutions that let our clients focus on what matters most. From the hospital ward to the factory floor, we believe every organisation, from Kathmandu to the remote hills, deserves world-class technology.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To be the most trusted full-stack technology partner in South Asia — building a future where every healthcare worker, business and public institution has access to digital tools that are as powerful as they are intuitive, helping Nepal's healthcare system and economy reach their full potential.

values.title: Innovation
values.body: We push the boundaries of technology with creative solutions that solve real-world challenges — beginning with the hardest problems in healthcare.

values.title: Reliability
values.body: Critical systems never sleep. From hospital operations to enterprise infrastructure, our systems are built for 99.9% uptime with rock-solid infrastructure and redundancy.

values.title: Compassion
values.body: Every line of code we write is in service of the people and organisations we support — starting with better patient outcomes and a healthier Nepal.

contact.heading: Let's Build Something Great Together
contact.subheading: Looking to build better software, secure your network, move to the cloud or supply IT infrastructure — with a special focus on healthcare? Write to us and our team will respond within 24 hours.

footer.blurb: Full-stack IT services and infrastructure products for Nepal since 2019 — with healthcare at the core.
